thread:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PAGED — auth-service: sudden spike in 401/429s from eu-west frontends (rate > 3x baseline). Auto-run playbook 'auth-heartbeat'.

olivia (oncall-infra): acknowledged, I'm on it. pulling logs from eu-west-1 now.

leah (sre): seeing lots of repeated /v1/auth token exchange attempts, same UA 'okhttp/4.9.0', source netblocks look like 34.120.96.0/20 and 35.190.0.0/16. Pattern: short-lived bursts every ~30s per IP.

andre (runtime): adding that the kv-cache hits drop for sessions hitting the auth proxy. Might be replaying old prefixes and causing backend to reject -> 401s.

sam (sec-lead): initial ask: block suspicious netblocks at WAF and LB, rotate any exposed svc tokens we can fast. Also check our log-forwarder for leaked tokens.

olivia (oncall-infra): WAF rule queued: block IP ranges noted, temporary 15m. Applying now. ops_bot, run deploy rule #waf-block-2869501110?

ops_bot: WAF rule deploy started by olivia. change_id=chg-9876. ETA 20s. :gear:

ops_bot: WAF rule active in eu-west. Status: propagated to edge nodes.

leah (sre): running quick grep on logs for 'Authorization:' headers that match our internal svc token pattern. found ~7 hits forwarded to logs-prod-archive via logshipper-us-east. Suspect redaction missed.

leah (sre): snippet (sanitized):
```
2026-08-14T11:22:03Z auth-proxy eu-west nginx "POST /v1/auth" 401 "Authorization: Bearer svc_ABC***def" src=34.120.99.12
```

sam (sec-lead): ok we need immediate rotation of svc_ABC and any sibling tokens used by log-forwarder. Maya, can you confirm which customers might be affected if we revoke svc_ABC?

maya (cs): svc_ABC is used by internal ingestion pipeline for PartnerX sandbox. No customer production traffic relies on it, but PartnerX dev ingest will fail until rotated. I'll open a brief incident comms if we revoke.

andre (runtime): plan: 1) rotate svc_ABC (immediate) 2) add fallback to token-checker so auth service rejects replayed tokens faster 3) enable stricter rate-limiting per IP for /v1/auth in eu-west only. I'll queue changes to runtime config.

olivia (oncall-infra): rotating svc_ABC now. Steps: create new key, update secrets in secrets-manager (rot-2869501110), patch logshipper credentials to avoid forwarding old token.

ops_bot: secrets-manager update requested. rotate_id=rot-2869501110 status=started.

leah (sre): searching for other logshipper destinations. Found one forwarding to thirdparty-indexer partner-logs-eu. I've disabled that forwarder for the time being.

sam (sec-lead): legal/priv-team notified. Opening sec ticket SEC-2026-431 with timeline. Please paste any leaked lines there.

maria? (note: not in participants)

olivia (oncall-infra): rotation complete: new key created, old key revoked, logshipper creds patched. rot-2869501110 complete. ops_bot confirms secrets-manager shows new active key.

ops_bot: rotate_id=rot-2869501110 status=success.

andre (runtime): runtime config changes pushed to eu-west canary: stricter rate-limits and quick reject for repeated token prefix replays. I'll watch metrics for 10m.

leah (sre): after WAF + rotation, auth spike reduced to baseline within 3 minutes. No increased 5xxs. No evidence of exfil beyond the few lines we found in logshipper archive.

maya (cs): PartnerX informed via private slack DM, explained temporary dev ingest outage and rotation. No customer data other than their sandbox logs were in forwarded archive.

sam (sec-lead): follow-ups: 1) full scan of log-forwarder configs across regions (leah) 2) add redaction tests in CI for auth headers (devex + andre) 3) post-incident review and legal note (sam).

leah (sre): creating postmortem ticket INC-2869501110-PM and linking findings.

olivia (oncall-infra): handing off to night oncall in 28m. I'll leave the canary and rotation alerts on my watch for another 30m.

andre (runtime): monitoring metrics dashboard: auth_401_rate eu-west back to normal. Keeping increased logging (sanitized) for 2 hours.

sam (sec-lead): good work team. tagging :thumbsup: I'll add timeline and any leaked snippets to SEC-2026-431.

maya (cs): closing customer loop after postmortem.

olivia (oncall-infra): incident status -> mitigated, impact: limited (dev sandbox only), keys rotated, WAF rule removed after 15m, follow-ups created.

ops_bot: incident record updated: INC-2869501110 severity=medium status=mitigated.

leah (sre): leaving logs and grep queries in the ticket. Example query for future triage:
```bash
# search for raw auth tokens in forwarded logs (sanitize before sharing)
grep -R "Authorization: Bearer svc_" /var/log/forwarded-archives/* | sed -n '1,50p'
```

sam (sec-lead): assigning actions: sec:sam -> SEC-2026-431 (lead), sre:leah -> INC-2869501110-PM (postmortem), runtime:andre -> runtime redaction CI, devex -> add test doc.

olivia (oncall-infra): next steps done. handing off. :white_check_mark:

pagerbot: Incident closed on-call handoff: olivia -> night-oncall in 30m.
